title: Fastned - Kia e-Soul 39 kWh (2020-2022) charge graph
notes: Charge graph embedded in the Fastned vehicle page (e-Soul 39 kWh (2020 - 2022), charger class 50+), one kW value per SoC %, read with curl. Page carries no reuse terms and the Fastned terms of use have no clause on vehicle chart data (owner confirms). Fastned says curves assume a battery near 30 C.
